title: RAID DETAILS ARE SHORT
why: His order of 2026-10-09: a raid line is a short caps headline with a short detail only when needed, never an explaining sentence, and a key is always named in brackets. The detail under NO FRAG CHARGE LEFT and EMPTY SLOT read Press 5 for your gun. (LB or RB to your gun. on a pad); it now reads [5] GUN or [LB] [RB] GUN. The Survivor says Needs Armour Plate., and with too few rounds NOT ENOUGH AMMUNITION with Needs 40 rounds. Hot ground says Bonus loot., the seal Seal payout dropped., and a dead hire names the real amount, Death benefit $3,400 owed., instead of You owe his family. System lines are caps only: CONTROLLER DISCONNECTED with RECONNECT TO RESUME, RECORDING with [F9] STOP and 3:00 MAX, and SAVED TO DOWNLOADS. CANNOT STOW THAT GUN stands alone and the loaner headline is LOANER GUN.
now: Raid details are short callouts, and the gun key reads [5] GUN.
